relevance_note: Supplementary Table S2 gives individual-level data (sex, ages, TNFAIP3 genotype, initial diagnosis, treatment) for the nine HA20 patients: "nine patients (from six unrelated families) in the study were diagnosed with HA20".
method_note: Read by hand; a short Python script assembled the JSON and cut spans from the fixed-width text lines of supplementary Table S2 (checked against the table). Scope: only the nine HA20 patients of Table S2 are in scope; the other cohort members (undiagnosed patients P1-19 in Table 2 incl. the PSMB8 patient, IPH, CAEBV/HMB patients, controls) get no rows. Labels: Table S2's 'Patient' column holds bare numbers 1-9 (5a, 6a, 7a carry footnote 'a'), so labels are 'Table S2 #<n>'; this also avoids confusion with the different people numbered 1-19 in Table 2. Table S2 is a PDF-converted fixed-width table: each patient's protein change, part of the diagnosis and treatment wrap onto the next line, so multi-line values use span lists; 'adrenal insufficiency' (#9) and 'Early childhood' (#7) are split across lines and quoted as two spans. Age at IS analysis recorded as age at last evaluation; 'Disease-onset age' as age at onset. Features come from the 'Initial diagnosis before genetic analysis' and 'Symptoms at IS analysis' columns; diagnosis labels SLE (#1) and 'FMF like autoinflammatory disease' (#5) were not recorded as features. Crohn's disease / intestinal Behçet's disease / intestinal BD mapped to the GI inflammation checklist item, Hashimoto's disease to autoimmune thyroiditis, lymphadenitis to lymphadenopathy, pJIA/sJIA/psoriatic arthritis to arthritis. 'Stomatitis' (#4, #7) was not mapped to oral ulcers. CRP at IS analysis (mg/L) values were not judged elevated or normal because the paper gives no reference range; checklist left not reported. 'Symptoms at IS analysis: None' was not used to exclude anything. 'All patients had elevated ISs' applied to all nine as a group statement. Pathogenicity and NF-kB functional evidence recorded only for p.Lys329Asn*1 (#1) and p.Gly583* (#3), the two variants the text names; the others are only 'several previously reported variants (32)' without saying which. No variant types are stated by the authors. Inheritance: footnote says Patients 6 and 7 are the mother and grandmother of patient 5, all three with c.2209delC, so #5 is inherited maternal; #6's relation to #7 (her mother or mother-in-law) is not stated, so #6 is not reported. Text says six unrelated families but does not say which other patients are related (#2 and #4 share c.133C>T; relationship not stated, not inferred). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is true only because Table 2 footnote c says Patients 7 and 11 (undiagnosed, non-HA20, out of scope) were previously studied (34, 35); no HA20 patient is said to be previously reported. Gene symbol TNFAIP3 is not printed in Table S2; taken from the main-text sentence on the HA20 patients' TNFAIP3 variants. No contradictions found.
